quote_reserve.meaning: reserves[token].quoteReserve, the curve's quote-token reserve for the token

virtual_quote.meaning: VIRTUAL_QUOTE constant threshold for the curve's quote reserve

quote_reserve_low.meaning: the curve has few quoteReserves, as in early token launch or after many users sell back tokens

sell_completed.meaning: the holder's Launchpad::sell call completes without the quoteBoughtByCurve revert

assumptions: The last seller is a token holder attempting to sell back tokens on the curve.
The sell path invokes quoteBoughtByCurve(token) which reverts when quoteReserve is below VIRTUAL_QUOTE.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric value or definition for VIRTUAL_QUOTE; treated as a symbolic constant.
The qualitative 'few quoteReserves' fact has no numeric bound in the report; represented as a grounded Boolean condition pending code binding.

limitations: The condition uses sell_completed as the valid-sell scenario trigger; the report does not separately define a pre-sell holder state beyond the reserve bound.
Whether quoteReserve actually falls below VIRTUAL_QUOTE is described as potential, not observed; the plan formalizes the conditional obligation only.
